propositions: CodeQL flagged five clear-text-logging-sensitive-data alerts across _commands/__init__.py and _commands/_seam.py that are taint over-approximations with no credential material actually reaching logs or stdout.

Alerts 86/87 in _seam.py flag data["secret_override"]["families"] which contains only literal detector category names from SECRET_PATTERNS, never credential values, by deliberate design of SecretFinding dataclass.
Alerts 83/84/85 in __init__.py flag argv echoed in usage errors, but the --allow-secret-pattern token is stripped from rest before printing so the tainted value cannot reach any of the three prints.
All five alerts were dismissed via code-scanning API with false-positive justification and supporting evidence comments.
Regression tests were added to pin the invariant that credential values and override reasons never appear in logs at both the library and CLI forced-write routes.
